_comment: Chinh sach quyen cho bot (extension bot-permissions). ask (can duyet): mau trong bash/read/write/tools.ask khong bi chan cung ma xin bot dieu phoi duyet (RPC: hoi ngay qua extension_ui_request; -p/json: needs_permission + CLI lib/permissions-cli.mjs). Thu tu: luat cung -> deny -> ask -> allow -> mac dinh. ask THANG allow (nghiem hon) nen duoc dung de khoanh vung trong allow rong; luat cung va deny KHONG bao gio ask duoc. ask.timeoutMs: het gio = tu choi. mode: allowlist (mac dinh, chi lenh khop allow moi chay) | denylist (chay tat tru deny). deny luon thang allow. Luat cung (path jail, .env/.git/credential, sudo, rm -r rong, curl|sh, dump env) luon ap dung, khong tat duoc. bash.sandbox: lenh test/build (khop allow) chay ma cua repo => chi tu chay trong coder-sandbox (CODER_SANDBOXED=1 + PID1 la bwrap); ngoai sandbox => ask (rule bash.sandbox). bunx: luat cung chi cho 'bunx -p typescript@5.9.3 tsc ...' (dung phien ban) hoac 'bunx tsc ...' khi co node_modules/typescript cuc bo / vendor tsc trong sandbox; goi khac va 'bun x' bi chan. Trong coder-sandbox, lenh khop bash.sandbox duoc boc vao sandbox LONG (lib/sandbox-exec.sh: khong mang, env allowlist khong key, agent-dir/.env/bots bi che). 'bunx *' van nam trong bash.sandbox (phong thu nhieu lop): neu luat cung bunx co lo, lenh van khong tu chay ngoai sandbox va trong sandbox van vao lop long khong mang/khong key. Mau lenh: glob ('*' khop moi thu) hoac 're:<regex>' khop ca doan lenh. Mau duong dan kieu gitignore ('.env*' khop o moi cap, 'dir/' = ca thu muc, '**'). Moi dau ; && || | tach thanh doan lenh rieng va TUNG doan phai duoc allow. LUAT CUNG THEM (khong tat duoc): (1) moi token co mo rong bien/${..}/$1/$(..)/backtick/brace {a,b}/~user ngoai dau nhay don => chan; glob * ? [ chi duoc o toan hang DUONG DAN (thanh phan cuoi) cua lenh doc/liet ke; (2) cac lenh ls cat head tail wc sort uniq diff cmp file stat du tree grep rg fd find sed jq git echo mkdir touch cp mv... chi chap nhan CO nam trong whitelist co cua lenh do (vd sed chi -n + N,Mp; find cam -exec/-delete/-fprint*; git cam -c/--exec-path/-O/--output/--ext-diff...); co la => chan, mau allow o day chi quyet dinh lenh nao duoc chay.
